narrative: 信任调度本身。一个厨房、一条走廊、一个舞台：人们进入、劳作、离开，而画面始终是不可更改的法则。
因为摄影机拒绝提供任何帮助，时长本身变得可见。如果一个眼神或一次站位需要重新构图才能让权力关系可读，那么这就不是合适的工具。
如果你出于“善意”开始漂移，那就不再是固定摄影机，而只是一次胆怯的摇镜头。
how: 三脚架、壁挂，或隐藏的锁定装置。选定高度（通常是视平高度，或较正式的胸部高度）和能容纳整个房间的镜头（通常在35到50mm之间）。
景深要足够深，让不止一个层次的动作都能被看清。提示词：Fixed camera on [Subject], locked position and tilt, all motion belonging to the world, not the operator.
when: 当这场戏依靠调度本身时使用：家务劳作、一场仪式、一个发生在全景中的笑点。不要为了追一句台词而松开机头。
vs: 固定机位（Static Locked-Off）是把“无运动”作为一种镜头运动类别来归类的说法。活人画（Tableau）则是一种场面调度理念：把画面构成一幅可供阅读的图像。
固定摄影机是关于摄影机运动的规则：支撑装置完全不参与运动。哪怕只是稍作调整的摇镜头，也已经是另一种约定了。
examples_film: 《让娜·迪尔曼》（Jeanne Dielman, 23 quai du Commerce, 1080 Bruxelles）长时间停留在房间里，直到家务本身变成了整部电影。《夺魂索》（Rope）常被拿来当作长镜头的例子，但那些镜头是在移动的；真正的固定摄影机不会移动。
把阿克曼（Akerman）当作固定机位语法的范本。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是缓慢的游移，或有动机的摇镜头。破绽在于：画面会轻轻调整，以让一张脸保持居中。
解决办法：选定一个构图，锁定摇镜头和俯仰角，如果必要，就让人物走出画面。

faq.q: 电影中的固定摄影机（Fixed Cam）是什么？
faq.a: 固定摄影机在位置和俯仰角上都被锁定。人和天气可以变化，但操作者不会移动镜头。

faq.q: 固定摄影机（Fixed Cam）与活人画（Tableau）的区别
faq.a: 活人画是一种场面调度理念，是一幅供人阅读的画面。固定摄影机则是一条机械规则：支撑装置不做摇镜头、不做俯仰、不移动。两者常常同时出现，但并不是同一个概念。

faq.q: 什么时候该用固定摄影机（Fixed Cam）？
faq.a: 当调度本身足以撑起整场戏时使用：一个房间、一场仪式、一个发生在全景中的笑点。不要为了追台词而松开机头。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写固定摄影机（Fixed Cam）的提示词？
faq.a: 写明锁定的位置和俯仰角。示例：Fixed camera on [Subject], locked position and tilt, all motion belonging to the world, not the operator.

narrative: Trust blocking. A kitchen, a hallway, a stage: people enter, work, leave, and the frame stays a law.
Duration becomes visible because the camera refuses to help. It is the wrong tool when a look or a stand requires a reframe to keep power readable.
If you start drifting to be kind, you no longer have a fixed cam. You have a timid pan.
how: Sticks, a wall mount, or a hidden lock-off. Pick height (often eye or a formal chest) and a lens that holds the room (often 35 to 50mm).
Deep enough focus that action in more than one plane can be read. Prompt: Fixed camera on [Subject], locked position and tilt, all motion belonging to the world, not the operator.
when: Use it when the scene is blocking: chores, a ritual, a joke that happens in the wide. Do not free the head to chase a line.
vs: Static Locked-Off is the locked-off shot as a catalog size of move (none). Tableau is a staging idea: a composed field to be read as a picture.
Fixed cam is the camera-movement rule: the support does not participate. A Pan that only adjusts a little is already a different contract.
examples_film: Jeanne Dielman holds rooms until chores become the film. Rope is often cited for long takes, but those cameras travel; a true fixed cam would not.
Use Akerman as the lock-off grammar.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a slow wander or a motivated pan. The tell: the frame eases to keep a face centered.
The fix: pick a composition, lock pan and tilt, and let people leave the frame if they must.

faq.q: What is Fixed Cam in film?
faq.a: A fixed camera is locked in position and tilt. People and weather may move; the operator does not.
Tableau is a staging idea, a picture to be read. Fixed cam is the mechanical rule that the support does not pan, tilt, or travel. They often meet, but they are not the same word.

faq.q: When should I use Fixed Cam?
faq.a: Use it when blocking can carry the scene: a room, a ritual, a gag in the wide. Do not free the head to chase dialogue.

faq.q: How do I prompt Fixed Cam for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write a locked position and tilt. Example: Fixed camera on [Subject], locked position and tilt, all motion belonging to the world, not the operator.
